scope: Optional local diagnostic only; not default head reconstruction or multiview fusion

model.license_evidence: Official pinned model card explicitly lists MIT; source README explicitly includes pretrained models in its MIT release.
model.load_policy: Local path, exact hashes, torch.load(weights_only=True); no fallback checkpoint

architecture_config.purpose: Local ViT architecture JSON only; no separate DINO pretrained weights downloaded

local_adaptation.mesh_extraction: CPU scikit-image marching cubes replaces torchmcubes; asymmetric sphere axis/winding check required
local_adaptation.network: Offline model flags plus process-local socket connection denial before model import and photo reading; not a machine-wide network sandbox

runtime_version_policy: Package metadata versions above are recorded separately from torch.__version__. This JSON is an experiment record, not an automatically enforced production asset manifest.
privacy: Rights-validated input and every image/identity-derived artifact stay under ignored local assets/private; never upload to demos or include in Git
limitations: Generic single-image object generation, not a head-specific anatomy model or five-view reconstruction. Model/code grant does not certify all training data, output accuracy or complete binary redistribution. Dependency licenses and attribution remain separate. Source foreground hair is not bare-skull evidence; no hair-specific modeling is included. Successful loading or watertight output is not visual acceptance.
